headline: President Bush signed an order making the 2005 updates to the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military trials.
what_it_does: This order amends the Manual for Courts-Martial, which sets the procedures and rules of evidence for military criminal trials. No summary was provided, so the specific changes it makes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members charged with crimes under military law face trials run under the updated rules.

who_it_affects.group: Military judges, prosecutors, and defense lawyers
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the revised procedures when handling courts-martial cases.
